title: AgenticSystemCore bundle root
description: Frontmatter of content/index.md, the Bundle root document (AGSC-01-04). It MUST NOT carry a type key: the root is not an item and does not enter the graph as one. additionalProperties is true: unknown keys are preserved and reported as AGSC-E207 warnings (AGSC-02-05). CC0-1.0.

spec_version.description: SemVer; a reader MUST accept any Bundle whose MAJOR equals its own (AGSC-00-14, AGSC-00-17).

bundle_version.description: The content version of the Bundle state this document was written for (AGSC-04-25, rc.6, D113). Derived at build and never authored; it appears in the Bundle root document only of an `export --markdown`/`--okf` output (AGSC-01-26).

okf_version.description: Open Knowledge Format version this Bundle is a superset of; allowed at the bundle root only.

title.description: AGSC-02-24 as amended at rc.5 (FV28-01): an authored SINGLE-LINE string — no C0 control, no U+007F, U+0085, U+2028 or U+2029 — because AGSC-06-13a block (1) puts it on the `# ` line of /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt. A violation is AGSC-E204.

description.description: NOT single-line-bounded, deliberately: AGSC-06-13a block (3) emits this value with 'newlines in the source replaced by a single space', so a multi-line Bundle description is conforming and the writer collapses it (FV28-01).

base.description: Absolute https origin, trailing slash optional; the IRI base of every item (AGSC-01-19, AGSC-05-01). MUST equal site.base in agsc.config.json, including the http://localhost[:port]/ development placeholder written by adoption (D52(1)). No query, no fragment, and no path segment that is . or .. (AGSC-01-19, rc.5, V9A-14).

license.description: SPDX or LicenseRef identifier covering the prose of this Bundle (AGSC-06-15). Single-line: it is the `license:` line of the AGSC-06-13a provenance header (AGSC-02-24, rc.5, FV28-01).

operator.description: AGSC-02-07 as amended by D48(5): human:<id> only.
